description: I present a cumulative research programme on distinction, perspective, predictive closure, representation genesis, quantum instruments, prime arity, and recurrence. This complete release brings together eighteen specialist papers and one scientific atlas as a two-hundred-page research series, with individual submission packages, data, figures, formal derivations, executable audits, and provenance ledgers. Its central constructions include the occurrence-sensitive prime triad, the nine-state / thirty-six-relation prime-observer closure theorem, transparent-prime sector labels, a scoped quantum-number interpretation, the repdigit terminal lattice, and the corrected all-prime Möbius predictive quotient. Definitions, results proved within the formalism, representations, numerical checks, physical hypotheses, and open questions are kept explicitly distinct.
title: Distinction, Perspective, and Predictive Closure: Complete Research Release 8.0.2
